comparator.description: The careful-English arm states the full mapping in place of the marker ('moved to an earlier/later time than its current schedule'); contexts, times and probes are byte-identical across arms. The ambiguous bare idioms the construct replaces ('moved forward', 'pushed back') appear only in the calibration control's english arm.

attempt.estimand: Difference in schedule-direction comprehension accuracy between the marked forms moved-earlier / moved-later and the complete careful-English mapping, on rebase contexts where the event was already rescheduled once, so the mapping's load-bearing clause (direction is judged against the CURRENT schedule) is always live. Five settlement strata, equal weight, never pooled: direct application against the current slot (per form); transitive inference against the original slot, decidable only through the marker's current-schedule semantics; honestly undetermined original-slot cells, where over-inference is the failure the row exists to prevent; and explicit-new-time cells that guard against the marker degrading plain clock reading. Replaces four retracted same-instrument point originals with one attested item-bootstrap journal.
admissibility_gates: the reader alone clears the planted calibration control without retry selection
every probe's exact option strings appear in neither arm and never repeat the markers
the five strata are separate settlement strata; no pooled figure stands in for any

outside orig:undet the not-fixed option is never the key, and within every stratum the cold-default answer of a no-knowledge reader does not equal the planted key (the v1 leak, fixed by construction and asserted in the generator)
